name: Iridescent Button
summary: Conic-gradient React button with a cursor-tracking iridescent glow and an optional keyboard shortcut badge.
description: A shadcn registry component from Vanta UI. The button paints a conic gradient with a cursor-tracking iridescent glow — pointer coordinates are stored in CSS custom properties — and shows an optional keyboard shortcut badge; all standard button props are forwarded. Styling comes from the registry's globals.css and it depends on the utils registry item.
